raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Decompose the image into fragments and count non-H bonds in each: left benzene ring = 6, left phenyl–N bond = 1, N–C iminium/vinyl connection = 1, central C–C connection = 1, connection from central carbon to right phenyl = 1, right benzene ring = 6, upper alkene C=C connection = 1, alkene/carboxyl C–C connection = 1, carboxyl C=O connection = 1, and carboxyl C–O connection = 1. Exclude N–H and O–H. Sum these fragment counts to obtain 20.

method.method_draft: Assign heavy-atom incidence counts from the picture. Each substituted benzene ring contributes 12 ring incidences plus 1 exocyclic substituent incidence, so two rings give 26 incidences. The N/iminium/bridge part contributes 6 further incidences: N attached to phenyl and iminium carbon, iminium carbon attached to N and the next carbon, and that next carbon attached to iminium carbon and right phenyl. The upper alkene-carboxyl fragment contributes 8 incidences: alkene terminal carbon 1, adjacent alkene carbon 2, carboxyl carbon 3, carbonyl oxygen 1, hydroxyl oxygen 1. Total heavy-atom incidences = 26 + 6 + 8 = 40; divide by 2 to get 20 bonds.

图像描述：图中是一个带反应箭头的过渡态/反应结构示意。左侧有一个取代苯环连到带正电的氮原子，氮原子还连有氢，并与旁边的亚胺/碳链部分相连；右侧还有一个苯环连接到该碳链。上方有一个烯烃-羧酸片段，包含 C=C、羧基 CO2H 和羟基氧。题目要求忽略箭头，并且排除所有涉及氢的键。

按指定方法用重原子 incidence 计数：每个取代苯环有 6 个环内重原子键，对应 12 个环内 incidence；再加 1 个从苯环连到外部取代基的 incidence，所以每个苯环为 13 个 incidence。两个苯环共 13 × 2 = 26 个 incidence。N/亚胺/桥连部分再贡献 6 个 incidence：N 连到左苯环和亚胺碳，亚胺碳连到 N 和下一个碳，下一个碳连到亚胺碳和右苯环。上方烯烃-羧酸片段贡献 8 个 incidence：烯烃端碳 1，邻近烯烃碳 2，羧基碳 3，羰基氧 1，羟基氧 1。总 incidence = 26 + 6 + 8 = 40。每一条重原子键被两个端点各计一次，因此总键数 = 40 / 2 = 20。
